subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should the repository accept a coordinated TruffleHog v3.96.0 update that includes the job’s separately pinned scanner artifact and verified digest, or keep the existing wrapper version until those artifact pins are reviewed together?
rationale: The workflow runs security scanning, and the correct paired artifact digest is a trust-boundary choice that cannot safely be inferred from the wrapper version alone.

options.title: Update the complete scanner set
options.body: Advance the wrapper, scanner release, and verified artifact digest together after reviewing the upstream v3.96.0 artifact and proving the pull-request scan uses it.

options.title: Retain the current wrapper
options.body: Leave the existing TruffleHog wrapper pin in place and defer the update until the paired scanner artifact can be reviewed and changed atomically.

recommendation.title: Update the complete scanner set
recommendation.body: Advance the wrapper, scanner release, and verified artifact digest together after reviewing the upstream v3.96.0 artifact and proving the pull-request scan uses it.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable workflow ownership attribution was available in the supplied evidence.
